programme.subtitle: Create a private RDS for MySQL database, authorize EC2 through security groups, and prove the ALB-to-EC2 web path.
programme.description: In eu-west-2, use an existing VPC with subnets in at least two Availability Zones. Create separate security groups for an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB), an EC2 web server, and a private Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The ALB forwards HTTP requests to EC2. The RDS security group permits MySQL traffic only from the EC2 security group.
programme.displayName: RDS, EC2, and Application Load Balancer Follow Along
programme.learningOutcome: Create an RDS DB instance and a security-group chain where the path is client → ALB → EC2, while EC2 is authorized to reach RDS on MySQL port 3306. Verify a healthy ALB target, the static web response, the available DB instance, and the EC2-to-RDS security-group rule.

inputs.buildOutcome: Create and add a complete set of beginner-friendly hands-on labs for an RDS, EC2 and Application Load Balancer Follow Along in the existing Study Tracker app, focused specifically on the AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate SAA-C03 exam. Never leave Console actions, CLI actions, validation steps, IAM requirements, explanations or cleanup sections empty. Walk the learner through every important click, field, setting and command, explain what each important option does and why it matters, include expected results and verification steps, and keep programming to an absolute minimum. The active path must use eu-west-2 and an existing VPC with subnets in at least two Availability Zones. The learner must create separate security groups for an internet-facing Application Load Balancer, an EC2 web server and a private Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The ALB security group must allow inbound HTTP from the internet. The EC2 security group must allow inbound HTTP only from the ALB security group. The RDS security group must allow inbound MySQL traffic on port 3306 only from the EC2 security group.
